title: Chromakey Blocks Mod
description: This mod adds a working chromakey to minecraft
body:
## 📄 About

Chromakey Blocks Mod - mod that adds chromakey blocks in different colors. This mod is an ideal tool for content creators. 

![example of using chromakey block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe4b496687121e85e7576ed4d55d7826274bb0d8.jpeg)

## ⚒ Recipes

**Chromakey** - stone, lime dye and torch

![Chromakey Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/598de07abf02ea381608fe371906792c90daa907.png)

**Black Chromakey** - stone and black dye

![Black Chromakey Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca46dd14e3e8bff53468c6b70dd5b478f3a6c79e.png)

**White Chromakey** - stone and white dye

![White Chromakey Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9aaf8beedc21af5207b1bb6e3d32aea849a1aa2.png)
